Mode.description: Indicates the Retention mode for the specified object.

RetainUntilDate.description: The date on which this Object Lock Retention will expire.

EventHold.description: The event hold status for the object. Set to ON to enable an event hold or OFF to disable it.

EventHoldDuration.description: The event hold duration for the object. Specifies how long the object remains protected after the event hold is released.
